# tinycad_proto: C++ messages and gRPC stubs of the contract server/proto/tinycad/v1 (spec 14),
# generated by protoc and grpc_cpp_plugin from vcpkg at build time (decision N4: the protoc of
# the C++ code must match the protobuf library it links). Plus google/rpc/status.proto, the
# payload of the error details (spec 14, "Chyby").
set(TINYCAD_PROTO_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto")
set(TINYCAD_GOOGLEAPIS_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/googleapis")
set(TINYCAD_PROTO_GEN_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen")

file(GLOB TINYCAD_PROTOS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${TINYCAD_PROTO_DIR}/tinycad/v1/*.proto")

add_library(tinycad_proto STATIC)
target_sources(tinycad_proto PRIVATE ${TINYCAD_PROTOS}
  "${TINYCAD_GOOGLEAPIS_DIR}/google/rpc/status.proto")
target_link_libraries(tinycad_proto PUBLIC protobuf::libprotobuf gRPC::grpc++)
target_include_directories(tinycad_proto PUBLIC "${TINYCAD_PROTO_GEN_DIR}")

get_target_property(TINYCAD_PROTOBUF_INCLUDE protobuf::libprotobuf INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
set(TINYCAD_IMPORT_DIRS "${TINYCAD_PROTO_DIR}" "${TINYCAD_GOOGLEAPIS_DIR}"
  ${TINYCAD_PROTOBUF_INCLUDE})
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${TINYCAD_PROTO_GEN_DIR}")

protobuf_generate(TARGET tinycad_proto LANGUAGE cpp
  IMPORT_DIRS ${TINYCAD_IMPORT_DIRS}
  PROTOC_OUT_DIR "${TINYCAD_PROTO_GEN_DIR}")
protobuf_generate(TARGET tinycad_proto LANGUAGE grpc
  GENERATE_EXTENSIONS .grpc.pb.h .grpc.pb.cc
  PLUGIN "protoc-gen-grpc=$<TARGET_FILE:gRPC::grpc_cpp_plugin>"
  IMPORT_DIRS ${TINYCAD_IMPORT_DIRS}
  PROTOC_OUT_DIR "${TINYCAD_PROTO_GEN_DIR}")
